sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Prevention of Gambling Sindh Amendment Act 1972
sections.description:
Short tile and commencement

ACT XXIII OF 1972
ACT XXIII OF 1972
WEST PAKISTAN PREVENTION OF GAMBLING (SIND
AMENDMENT) ACT, 1972
An Act to amend the West Pakistan
Prevention of Gambling Ordinance, 1961,
in its application to the Province of Sind.
[Gazette of Sind, Extraordinary, 28th
December 1972]
(First
published after having received the assent of the Governor of Sind in the
Gazette of Sind (Extraordinary), dated the 28th December 1972).
1. Short tile and commencement.-(1)
This Act may be called the West Pakistan Prevention of Gambling (Sind Amendment)
Act, 1972.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Prevention of Gambling Sindh Amendment Act 1972
sections.description:
Amendment of section 2 of West Pakistan Ordinance I of 1961

ACT XXIII OF 1972
ACT XXIII OF 1972
WEST PAKISTAN PREVENTION OF GAMBLING (SIND
AMENDMENT) ACT, 1972
An Act to amend the West Pakistan
Prevention of Gambling Ordinance, 1961,
in its application to the Province of Sind.
[Gazette of Sind, Extraordinary, 28th
December 1972]
(First
published after having received the assent of the Governor of Sind in the
Gazette of Sind (Extraordinary), dated the 28th December 1972).
2. Amendment of section 2 of West Pakistan
Ordinance I of 1961.-- In the West Pakistan Prevention of Gambling
Ordinance, 1961, in its application to the Province of Sind, hereinafter
referred to as the Principal Ordinance, in section 2, after the word
"skill", the words and comma "or games played in a Tourist
Complex established, maintained and run under a licence" shall be added.

3. Amendment of section 3 of West Pakistan

full-stop at the end of clause (e) shall be replaced by a semicolon and the
word "and", and thereafter the following new clauses shall be added
:-
"(f
) 'Tourist Complex' means a private building or part thereof used for musical
or theatrical performances, entertainments and playing of various games for

4. Addition of sections of 11-A and ll-B to
West Pakistan Ordinance I of 1961.-- After section 11 of the Principal
Ordinance, the following new sections shall be added, namely t-
"11-A. Issue of licence.-Government may issue a licence
for establish. lug, maintaining, and running of a Tourist Complex on such
conditions as may be prescribed.
11-B.
Power to make rules.-Government may make rules for carrying into effect, the
provisions of this Ordinance, and in particular for-
(a)
prescribing conditions for grant of licence for Tourist Complex 1
(b)
regulating admission to the Tourist Complex ;
(c)
operation of various games to be played in the Tourist Complex."
